item.title: Last year, we introduced AlphaEvolve, our Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms. Today, it’s helping to discover better, fast...
item.description:
Last year, we introduced AlphaEvolve, our Gemini-powered coding agent for designing advanced algorithms. Today, it’s helping to discover better, faster ways to solve the world's most complex challenges.
Together with Google Cloud, AlphaEvolve is helping scientists and enterprises scale impact across fields like:
• Genomics: Improving the accuracy of DNA sequencing to help scientists find hidden disease-causing mutations more effectively.
• Disaster safety: Improving the prediction of risks like wildfires and floods — helping communities better prepare for natural disasters.
• Energy: Increasing the ability to find feasible power grid solutions, significantly reducing the need for costly post-processing steps for electricity grids.
• Logistics: Optimizing warehouse routing to save distance traveled — helping teams handle higher order volumes with their existing equipment and staff.
Learn more about the impact of AlphaEvolve → https://goo.gle/4u3pUEW

item.title: Today, we announced a new go-to hub for your health and wellness, plus a brand new wearable. 💪 The Google Health app combines everything you know a...
item.description:
Today, we announced a new go-to hub for your health and wellness, plus a brand new wearable.
💪 The Google Health app combines everything you know and love about the Fitbit experience with  advanced new capabilities and better insights, so you can understand the "why" behind your health trends. It’s free to use and integrates with hundreds of other apps and devices, like your Peloton or meal-logging apps.
📈 After six months in Public Preview, the Google Health Coach will also start rolling out to Google Health Premium subscribers in the coming weeks, offering even more personalized analysis and suggestions.  Google Health Premium benefits will also be included in Google AI Pro and Ultra plans.
👟 We’re also introducing our first screenless wearable: the Fitbit Air. It’s simple, comfortable and notification-free, with a battery life of up to a week and a variety of band styles for every mood and occasion. Available for pre-order today starting at $99.99.
Learn more about all the updates coming to Google Health →  https://goo.gle/49icyMA
* Works with most phones running on Android 11 or higher and Apple iOS 16.4 or higher. Requires Google Account and Google Health app. Not intended for medical purposes. See g.co/health/fitbit-air for details. * Battery life depends upon many factors and usage and actual battery life may be lower. See g.co/fitbit/battery.

item.title: Read this before your next big work trip ⬇️ With Google Translate’s Live translate feature, you can get instant translations for 70+ languages dire...
item.description:
Read this before your next big work trip ⬇️
With Google Translate’s Live translate feature, you can get instant translations for 70+ languages directly through any pair of headphones.
To more naturally follow along with conversations as you go — whether it’s to listen to a speech or lecture or just tune into public transportation announcements — Live translate uses Gemini’s advanced speech models to preserve the tone, emphasis and cadence of the original speaker. That way, you can better navigate nuance and subtle vocal cues that may come up.
Just put on your headphones, open the Translate app, tap “Live translate” and hear a real-time translation in your preferred language.
Get more of our most-helpful travel hacks → https://goo.gle/3OKTIqE

item.title: Think you need to be an expert before you graduate? Software Engineer Abena says otherwise. “Being a student is the time to try as many things as pos...
item.description:
Think you need to be an expert before you graduate? Software Engineer Abena says otherwise. “Being a student is the time to try as many things as possible and to ask questions,” she says. “Your experiences are what will set you apart. Both your successes and failures will bring unique perspectives to what you do in the future.” Her key takeaway? Focus on asking questions and building a broad range of experiences.
Abena, now working on Colossus, our distributed file system, focuses on reliability and performance at scale. Her favorite part of the job is how her team collaborates to solve massive, real-world challenges. “No problem is too big for us, and I learn something new every day,” she says. “It’s rewarding to know that what I do can improve the lives of people around the world.”
Interested in a career like Abena’s? Explore our open roles → https://goo.gle/4noFyra
